checks:
from work import stable_unique
assert stable_unique(*(['z', 'a', 'z', 'b', 'a'],)) == ['z', 'a', 'b'], (['z', 'a', 'z', 'b', 'a'],)
assert stable_unique(*([1, 0, 2, 1],)) == [1, 0, 2], ([1, 0, 2, 1],)
assert stable_unique(*([],)) == [], ([],)

contract: Split a sequence into consecutive positive-sized chunks, keeping the remainder.
Merge overlapping half-open intervals, keep touching intervals separate and discard empty intervals.
Replace {x} by 42 and use doubled braces for literal braces. Inputs are valid format strings.
checks:
from work import expand
assert expand(*('{{x}}',)) == '{x}', ('{{x}}',)
assert expand(*('{x}',)) == '42', ('{x}',)
assert expand(*('{{{x}}}',)) == '{42}', ('{{{x}}}',)

contract: Keep the largest numeric version per key regardless of input order.
Decode URL query parameters, retaining repeated keys as lists, blank values and percent decoding.
checks:
from work import decode
assert decode(*('x=1&x=2&z=',)) == {'x': ['1', '2'], 'z': ['']}, ('x=1&x=2&z=',)
assert decode(*('a+b=%2B',)) == {'a b': ['+']}, ('a+b=%2B',)
assert decode(*('',)) == {}, ('',)

contract: Round up to the nearest integer multiple of a positive width, including negative values and exact multiples.
checks:
from work import ceil_bucket
assert ceil_bucket(*(10, 5)) == 10, (10, 5)
assert ceil_bucket(*(-6, 5)) == -5, (-6, 5)
assert ceil_bucket(*(0, 2)) == 0, (0, 2)
assert ceil_bucket(*(11, 5)) == 15, (11, 5)

contract: Normalize a relative POSIX path lexically, resolving dot-dot while preserving leading parents. Empty result is a single dot.
checks:
from work import relpath
assert relpath(*('a/b/../c',)) == 'a/c', ('a/b/../c',)
assert relpath(*('../../a',)) == '../../a', ('../../a',)
assert relpath(*('a/..',)) == '.', ('a/..',)

contract: Return at most n keys by descending count with lexicographic tie breaks. Nonpositive n returns empty.
